Plan vacations, handle visas and make bookings
Uses AI to plan vacations, handle visas and do all the bookings; the post also mentions AI filtering dating outreach.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The poster ran AI that filtered hundreds of dating outreach messages, letting dozens of live chats reach direct contact after chosen ones passed the filters. Separately the AI planned a vacation, handled the visa, and completed all bookings.
How it went
The user states it is going great and loves the setup, with no other results or shortfalls reported.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Plan a [number]-day trip to [destination] for [number] travelers from [departure city] between [date range], with a budget of [amount]. Check the visa requirements for my [nationality] passport, list the documents and steps I need, and find flight and hotel options that fit. Finish with a day-by-day itinerary and a shortlist of bookings, and pause to show me the details before paying for anything or submitting any visa form.
